summary: "Buy the Dip in These 4 Energy Stocks (The Next AI Boom Needs Them)," published 2026-09-30 on MarketBeat, features guest Gabe Marshank of Stanbury Research. Marshank opens with a bearish AI thesis: the $4.5T AI data-center buildout by 2030 can't earn its return, compute pricing is already declining, and neoclouds are commodities. He then pivots bullish on energy as the true AI bottleneck — arguing four energy names, down roughly 30%, could 3–5x in 2–3 years. Calls: AESI — BUY (guest pick), behind-the-meter off-grid power for data centers that sidesteps the 5–7 year interconnect queue; LBRT — BUY (guest pick), same behind-the-meter story plus fracking tech repurposed for enhanced geothermal, and the former CEO is now Energy Secretary; ORA — BUY (guest pick), enhanced geothermal veteran with always-on, near-zero marginal cost power; FVO — BUY (guest pick, below IPO price), pure-play EGS with a Google 2.4GW Cape Station contract, his "most interesting speculation." On the other side: CRWV — AVOID (guest), no future for neoclouds, "strong support at zero"; NBIS — AVOID (guest), same neocloud bear case; IREN — AVOID (guest), same bear case, with even peak-market pricing only "adequate." No stance flips this run.
